clean_source_blocks.text: The final operation to save the whale is being closely followed, after the failure of earlier attempts.
The final operation to save the whale is being closely followed across Germany, after the failure of earlier attempts to lure it away from the coast.
More than five weeks after a humpback whale became stranded in shallow waters on the German coast, a barge has ferried the animal out of German waters, en route to the North Sea.

First spotted in German coastal waters in early March, the whale is thought to have become entangled in netting before eventually becoming stranded on a sandbank on Timmendorfer Strand, near the town of Tra...
